signals.name: EUR/USD
signals.label: Volatility squeeze breakout
signals.exit_txt: Stop 1.5 ATR, target 3 ATR, time-stop 15 sessions.
signals.why: Volatility clusters and mean-reverts (Engle ARCH 1982); compressed ranges tend to be followed by range expansion, so a breakout from a squeeze has a better payoff profile.
reasons: Bollinger width in the bottom 15% of the last year within the past 5 sessions (now 35th pct)
History on EUR/USD: 35 trades, hit 46% (95% CI 30-62%), avg +0.17R net of costs
In the current normal-volatility regime: 14 trades, avg -0.27R
Data caveat: Large open-vs-previous-close gaps (median 0.45x avg range): feed mixes sessions or futures rolls -> backtest fills are less reliable
signals.invalidation: Thesis is wrong if price trades above 1.1167 (=-1R) or nothing happens by 2026-12-04.

signals.label: Failed breakout (rejection)
signals.exit_txt: Stop 1.25 ATR (beyond the rejection wick), target 2 ATR, time-stop 5 sessions.
signals.why: Liquidity grab / stop-run: price trades through a 20-day extreme, finds no follow-through and closes back inside the range -> trapped breakout traders fuel the reversal.
reasons: ...but closed back inside the range with IBS 0.81 (strong rejection)
